summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a monthly return of equity issuer on movements in securities for June 2026, submitted to the Hong Kong Exchange. The filing reports no changes in authorized or issued shares, with 1,238,960,393 ordinary shares outstanding and no treasury shares. It confirms compliance with the minimum public float requirement of 25%. This is a routine regulatory filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change.
